name: team
description: Delivery discipline for a small project, in one file and with no fleet machinery: split work into outcomes that can be judged, size each check to what a defect would cost, prove a check can fail before trusting it, delegate reads in parallel and writes one at a time, review a change before it lands, and let the reviewer and the author converge across up to five returns before deciding on that record.

interface.shortDescription: Small-project delivery discipline in one file
interface.longDescription: The working half of a CTO method for projects that do not need one: outcomes with acceptance instead of step lists, checks sized to the credible consequence of a defect, a failing form observed before a check counts as evidence, parallel reading and serial writing because subagents share one working copy, an independent read of the diff before a risky change lands, and a convergence loop the reviewer and the author finish between them — five returns, then a decision read from the round ledger.
defaultPrompt: Use $team:team to plan this work as judgeable outcomes, size each check to its risk, and review the change before it lands.
